title: The Goblin Trail
about: Goblins raid carts on the forest road east of Millbrook. Follow the road to their lair in the old watchtower and clear it. One way only: there's no turning back.

village.name: Millbrook
village.text: Millbrook's square smells of bread and woodsmoke. The reeve has posted a notice: goblins have been raiding carts on the forest road east of the village, and whoever clears the old watchtower they use as a lair will be paid in coin. The general store is open if you need supplies.

road.name: The Forest Road
road.text: The road east narrows between old oaks. Six miles on, the trees crowd close and the birdsong stops. Broken cart wheels lie in the ditch.

ambush.text: Arrows hiss out of the undergrowth: goblins, hidden in the ferns!

clearing.name: A Quiet Clearing
clearing.text: Past the ambush site, a mossy clearing offers a moment's peace, a good place for a short rest.

tower.name: The Ruined Watchtower
tower.text: The watchtower's lower hall is dim and dusty. The flagstones ahead look oddly uniform, and against the far wall sits an iron-bound chest with a heavy lock.

lair.name: The Goblin Lair
lair.text: Stairs lead down into a torchlit cellar that stinks of wet fur. A goblin in a dented chain shirt barks orders from a crate throne, flanked by two warriors.
lair.ending: With the lair cleared, the forest road is safe again. The reeve of Millbrook pays your reward.
